prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop website direction comp for VEEMAP homepage
Primary request: Design the first viewport for "The Cycle Counter", translating seven-segment machine displays, production counters, and industrial HMI panels into an ultra-premium persuasive homepage for VEEMAP Technologies.
Input images: Image 1 is the VEEMAP orange-and-green chevron logo reference; preserve its recognizable geometry in the navigation, cleanly and without redesign.
Scene/backdrop: edge-to-edge matte black industrial display enclosure, no floating browser frame.
Subject: a conceptually accurate, non-proprietary high-speed special-purpose machine silhouette and cutaway mechanism integrated with a monumental production counter; compact supporting system status panel; not a generic software dashboard.
Style/medium: realistic shippable website UI mockup, exact industrial instrumentation grammar, premium material realism, not concept art and not a poster.
Composition/framing: 16:9 landscape desktop first viewport. Slim navigation across the top. Left half dominated by huge seven-segment "170 PPM" and a concise proposition with one illuminated action. Right half shows the machine silhouette/cutaway and a compact systems board with three states. Reveal the top edge of the next proof section to show this can govern a full homepage.
Lighting/mood: controlled red LED diffusion on matte near-black; precise, engineered, confident.
Color palette: matte black #070707; LED red #FF3B30 as the dominant lit state; amber #FFB000 for attention; green #00F566 for confirmed state; unlit segments #282828. Preserve VEEMAP orange/green only in the logo.
Materials/textures: matte black enclosure, ghost segment cells, brushed aluminium hardware edges, realistic LED diffusion, fine engraved legends.
Text (verbatim): "VEEMAP", "170 PPM", "BUILT AROUND YOUR PROCESS.", "High-speed mechanisms, vision and control engineered as one machine.", "TELL US YOUR TARGET", "VISION READY", "HMI CONNECTED", "HEALTH MONITORED".
Constraints: render all text exactly once and legibly; the visitor must understand special-purpose industrial automation within seconds; one obvious CTA; no fake customers or unsourced claims; no proprietary RIEKE machine detail; no people; no watermark.
Avoid: nostalgic alarm-clock styling; generic finance or analytics dashboard; bento cards; red cyberpunk glow; sci-fi HUD clutter; generic black-neon tech landing page; tiny unreadable labels.
